label: Bold swell
notes: One hand at a third of its usual length fills the sheet; it swells smoothly into round heads at its loudest stresses (the slow part of the swell stays a line, only the head blooms). Ian, round 11: "very nice, very promising". Controls: the hand, the swell's profile (drop, press, lens, momentum, turn; the sheet's (c) is meander69 + press, (d) marden + turn), head size, tail length, how long the line is, the seed — and occasional dots, off by default. Ian on round 11's dots: "I like 3 7" (counted 1, 2, 3; the line winding into dots at its turns) and "not crazy about split and wound. others can be useful from time to time": count slides each group just past its mass; turns places dots on the quiet stretches. Split is not offered. Version 2 (2026-10-19, Ian): the line no longer runs through the middle of a swell; it stops at the mass's edge.

recipe.label: a  one gesture, the sheet: shikasta, two loud stresses, drop (head 22 mm), pen 0.6
